Bash(PYTHONPATH=/home/jeremy python3 - <<'EOF'
from aegis.layers.multimodal.format_validator import FormatValidator, FormatValidationResult

v = FormatValidator\(\)

# PDF
r = v.validate\(b"%PDF-1.4 ..."\)
assert r.detected_format == "pdf", r.detected_format
assert r.threat_score == 0.0

# ZIP with vbaProject.bin raw bytes
import zipfile, io
buf = io.BytesIO\(\)
with zipfile.ZipFile\(buf, "w"\) as zf:
    zf.writestr\("word/vbaProject.bin", b"\\x00"\)
zip_data = buf.getvalue\(\)
r = v.validate\(zip_data, declared_type="application/zip"\)
assert r.detected_format == "zip"
assert r.has_macros, "should detect VBA macros"
assert r.threat_score >= 0.4

# Polyglot: PDF magic + HTML in body
poly = b"%PDF-1.4 <html><body>hello</body></html>"
r = v.validate\(poly\)
assert r.is_polyglot, "should be polyglot"
assert r.threat_score >= 0.5

# Embedded PE
data = b"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n" + b"\\x00" * 100 + b"MZ" + b"\\x00" * 10
r = v.validate\(data\)
assert r.has_embedded_executables
assert r.threat_score >= 0.6

# Format mismatch
r = v.validate\(b"%PDF-1.4", declared_type="text/html"\)
assert r.format_mismatch
assert "mismatch" in r.warnings[0].lower\(\)

# OLE2 macros
r = v.validate\(b"\\xd0\\xcf\\x11\\xe0\\xa1\\xb1\\x1a\\xe1"\)
assert r.detected_format == "ole2"
assert r.has_macros

# PDF JS
r = v.validate\(b"%PDF-1.4\\n/JavaScript \(alert\('xss'\)\)"\)
assert r.has_macros

print\("All assertions passed"\)
EOF)
